IMP GORDIANVS PIVS FEL AVG ; PM TR III COS II P P

A Roman copper alloy AS of Gordinian III (AD 238-244), Rome mint. Reece period 12 (AD 238-260), RIC: IVb Gordinian III 306b. The coin is very worn and has a green patina. Obverse: Laureate, draped, bust right. Legend: IMP GORDIANVS PIVS FEL AVG. Reverse: Gordian, in armour, holding globe and transverse spear. S C across fields. Legend: PM TR III COS II P P.
